title: Mushishi Zoku Shou 2nd Season
synopsis:
Ghostly, primordial beings known as Mushi continue to cause mysterious changes in the lives of humans. The travelling Mushishi, Ginko, persists in trying to set right the strange and unsettling situations he encounters. Time loops, living shadows, and telepathy are among the overt effects of interference from Mushi, but more subtle symptoms that take years to be noticed also rouse Ginko's concern as he passes from village to village.

Through circumstance, Ginko has become an arbiter, determining which Mushi are blessings and which are curses. But the lines that he seeks to draw are subjective. Some of his patients would rather exercise their new powers until they are utterly consumed by them; others desperately strive to rid themselves of afflictions which are in fact protecting their lives from devastation. Those who cross paths with Mushi must learn to accept seemingly impossible consequences for their actions, and heal wounds they did not know they had. Otherwise, they risk meeting with fates beyond their comprehension.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Seres primordiales fantasmales conocidos como Mushi continúan provocando cambios misteriosos en la vida de los humanos. El viajero Mushishi, Ginko, persiste en intentar corregir las situaciones extrañas e inquietantes que encuentra. Los bucles temporales, las sombras vivientes y la telepatía se encuentran entre los efectos abiertos de la interferencia de Mushi, pero síntomas más sutiles que tardan años en notarse también despiertan la preocupación de Ginko mientras pasa de aldea en aldea.

Debido a las circunstancias, Ginko se ha convertido en un árbitro que determina qué Mushi son bendiciones y cuáles son maldiciones. Pero las líneas que intenta trazar son subjetivas. Algunos de sus pacientes preferirían ejercer sus nuevos poderes hasta que los consumieran por completo; otros luchan desesperadamente por librarse de aflicciones que en realidad protegen sus vidas de la devastación. Aquellos que se cruzan con Mushi deben aprender a aceptar consecuencias aparentemente imposibles de sus acciones y curar heridas que no sabían que tenían. De lo contrario, corren el riesgo de encontrarse con destinos que escapan a su comprensión.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Cushion of Grass
episodes_data.description: In time and place unknown, the boy with white hair and green eyes sees the light illuminating the natural order and his own place in the world.

episodes_data.title: The Fragrant Darkness
episodes_data.description: What lingers in his distant memory is the knowledge of a spring that will not yet come for many years. The only self who knows that scent is the self who knows it not just yet. If his life is a chimera, for whom did he endure all these years?

episodes_data.title: Lingering Crimson
episodes_data.description:
Dusk--an uncertain hour that is neither day nor night.
When two long shadows intersect, a darkness awakens from its long slumber.

episodes_data.title: Hidden Cove
episodes_data.description:
There are channels that exist in this world unbeknownst to man.
At times, man can send their thoughts to traverse these paths at will to another and share the same thoughts.

episodes_data.title: Thread of Light
episodes_data.description: A lost boy seeks solace, but the skies only offer a glimpse of unattainable affection. Man is capable of becoming attuned to what lies outside of the five senses--the brilliance of life, the light that shines from within.

episodes_data.title: Sea of Otherworldly Stars
episodes_data.title_es: Mar de estrellas de otro mundo
episodes_data.description: A myriad stars adorn a solitary patch of an otherwise pitch-dark sky above her. The girl gazes upon the eerie sky and familiar light.

episodes_data.title: Azure Waters
episodes_data.description: Thirsting for and beguiled by water, the boy continues to live his life, as though lost or responding to a distant memory from the womb...

episodes_data.title: Lightning's End
episodes_data.description: Unanswered hopes and unheard feelings lead one to seek out signs that will guide them forward through the suffocating darkness that not even lightning can illuminate.

episodes_data.title: Mud Grass
episodes_data.description: Death clings and grows, what should have stayed in the ground has started to creep up.

episodes_data.title: Tree of Eternity
episodes_data.description: The one place that has stood the test of time, but humans have come.  But the memories aren’t lost.
